headline: Pakistan Railways has declared an emergency until 31 December on Railways Minister Hanif Abbasi's instructions, cancelling field officers' leave for three months amid rising train accidents.

card.desc: Field officers' leave cancelled after 55+ accidents this year.

caption:
Pakistan Railways has declared an emergency until 31 December on Railways Minister Hanif Abbasi's instructions, cancelling field officers' leave for three months, Express Tribune reports. Officers must supervise train operations on Sundays after more than 55 accidents since 1 January, Arab News adds.
